name: Keyline
description: A keyline of five dots, turned a fifth of a circle in some cells so the ring reads as loose.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @m5(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.62; move: 0.5 0.5) / 24% 24% no-repeat); mask: @m5(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.62; move: 0.5 0.5) / 24% 24% no-repeat); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 36deg, 72deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 36deg, 72deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
